raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

DeepSeek-V4.1 reuses compressed Main KV and indexer K state across groups of layers. The existing NVIDIA implementation resolves these states only from modules on the same PP rank and explicitly rejects a cut inside a KV-sharing group. For this 40-layer checkpoint, whose KV source layers are `[2, 8, 14, 20]`, PP2 is therefore limited to the group boundaries `2/38`, `8/32`, `14/26`, and `20/20`.

Those legal cuts do not balance the actual Prefill work well. With SWA bounded replay enabled, the early layers process the full prompt while the layers after the final KV source process only the trailing 128 tokens. In our 8K, Concurrency 8 profile, the two practical baseline cuts, `14/26` and `8/32`, left 1.92x and 1.62x PP-stage imbalances respectively, producing a substantial pipeline bubble.

This PR supports arbitrary nonempty PP partitions by relaying live Main KV, indexer K, top-k indices, and candidate blocks across stage boundaries and registering receiver-side cache replicas. This adds state-transfer and replica overhead, but the measured overhead is much smaller than the bubble removed by a better partition: `11/29` reduces the stage ratio to 1.08x and improves end-to-end Prefill throughput by about 19% versus the fastest supported baseline. See Validation below.

## Claims

- Support arbitrary nonempty partitions through `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION`, including cuts inside KV-sharing groups.
- Relay Main KV, indexer K, top-k indices, and candidate blocks across PP stages while retaining paged cache replicas for prefix caching.
- Preserve packed cache bytes and source compression ratios, and reject unsupported execution combinations before layer construction.

## Validation

### Environment and server command

Tested on two 8 x H20 hosts, one PP2/TP4 service per host. Image uses:

```text
vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-df3bd094aeea829f27baa0a5282830464f601d9f
```

The PR source was applied on top of that image. The relevant server command was:

```bash
CUT=11  # use 8 or 14 for the supported baselines

VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 \
VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION="${CUT},$((40 - CUT))" \
VLLM_DEEP_GEMM_WARMUP=skip \
vllm serve /models/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 \
  --served-model-name deepseek-v4.1-flash \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 31106 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 2 \
  --prefill-context-parallel-size 1 \
  --decode-context-parallel-size 1 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --attention-backend FLASHMLA_SPARSE_DSV41 \
  --moe-backend humming \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_ds_mla \
  --block-size 64 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --swa-bounded-replay \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --max-num-seqs 32 \
  --max-model-len 65536 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --enforce-eager \
  --async-scheduling \
  --safetensors-load-strategy prefetch \
  --api-server-count 1 \
  --renderer-num-workers 2 \
  --profiler-config '{"profiler":"torch","torch_profiler_dir":"/tmp/pr63106-profile","torch_profiler_with_stack":false,"torch_profiler_record_shapes":true,"ignore_frontend":true}'
```

### PP bubble and relay overhead

The profile used 24 cold 8192-token / 1-token requests at Concurrency 8 and captured all eight ranks. Values below are GPU kernel time per request averaged over the four TP ranks in each stage. PP SendRecv is excluded and TP collectives are included. The absolute PP0/PP1 work gap is used as the pipeline bubble proxy.

| Partition | PP0 work (ms/request) | PP1 work (ms/request) | Stage-work gap (ms/request) | Longer / shorter |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Baseline 14/26 | 325.8 | 169.9 | 155.9 | 1.92x |
| Baseline 8/32 | 190.6 | 309.5 | 118.9 | 1.62x |
| PR 11/29 | 258.9 | 239.0 | 19.9 | 1.08x |

At `11/29`, the measured Main KV + indexer K + top-k relay components were 0.034 ms PP0 pack/init, 0.043 ms PP send, 0.037 ms PP receive, 0.116 ms PP1 TP gather, and 0.039 ms PP1 copy/scatter per request per TP lane. Even their conservative arithmetic sum is only 0.269 ms; it is not a wall-clock latency because send/receive overlap and receive time includes peer waiting. This is orders of magnitude smaller than reducing the stage-work gap from 155.9 ms (`14/26`) or 118.9 ms (`8/32`) to 19.9 ms. Candidate-block relay was not exercised by `11/29` because its source is layer 20.

### End-to-end benchmark

The public CLI equivalent of the closed-loop matrix is:

```bash
BASE_URL=http://<server>:31106
MODEL=deepseek-v4.1-flash

for INPUT_LEN in 8192 16384 32768; do
  for CONCURRENCY in 1 8 16; do
    NUM_PROMPTS=$((10 * CONCURRENCY))
    curl -fsS -X POST "${BASE_URL}/reset_prefix_cache"
    vllm bench serve \
      --backend vllm \
      --base-url "${BASE_URL}" \
      --endpoint /v1/completions \
      --model "${MODEL}" \
      --dataset-name random \
      --random-input-len "${INPUT_LEN}" \
      --random-output-len 1 \
      --num-prompts "${NUM_PROMPTS}" \
      --max-concurrency "${CONCURRENCY}" \
      --request-rate inf \
      --seed 42 \
      --ignore-eos
  done
done
```

The recorded harness sent deterministic token-ID arrays directly, with `temperature=0`, `add_special_tokens=false`, and `ignore_eos=true`, and reset the prefix cache before every case. Each cell below is from an unprofiled closed-loop run.

| Input | Partition | Mean TTFT ms, Concurrency 1 | Mean TTFT ms, Concurrency 8 | Mean TTFT ms, Concurrency 16 | Input tok/s, Concurrency 1 | Input tok/s, Concurrency 8 | Input tok/s, Concurrency 16 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 8K | Baseline 14/26 | 517 | 2,507 | 4,947 | 15,848 | 25,008 | 25,245 |
| 8K | Baseline 8/32 | 517 | 2,393 | 4,694 | 15,844 | 26,199 | 26,611 |
| 8K | PR 11/29 | 516 | 2,013 | 3,955 | 15,860 | 31,143 | 31,583 |
| 16K | Baseline 14/26 | 858 | 4,989 | 9,909 | 19,092 | 25,115 | 25,205 |
| 16K | Baseline 8/32 | 839 | 4,743 | 9,409 | 19,531 | 26,419 | 26,542 |
| 16K | PR 11/29 | 793 | 3,978 | 7,901 | 20,663 | 31,497 | 31,610 |
| 32K | Baseline 14/26 | 1,537 | 9,993 | 19,872 | 21,303 | 25,076 | 25,135 |
| 32K | Baseline 8/32 | 1,488 | 9,544 | 18,999 | 22,017 | 26,257 | 26,291 |
| 32K | PR 11/29 | 1,343 | 8,007 | 15,909 | 24,382 | 31,296 | 31,393 |

At Concurrency 8/16 across 8K-32K inputs, `11/29` improves Input throughput by 24.5%-25.4% and reduces Mean TTFT by 19.7%-20.3% versus `14/26`. Versus the faster `8/32` baseline, it improves Input throughput by 18.7%-19.4% and reduces Mean TTFT by 15.7%-16.3%. These service-level gains agree with the profile: the benefit from removing the PP bubble is much larger than the cross-stage relay overhead.

All listed arms completed 4740/4740 formal requests with zero cache-hit increments, preemptions, or restarts, and all requests had the expected length finish. The 8K/16K/32K one-token smoke outputs matched across the listed arms. Full accuracy or logit-equivalence evaluation was not run.

### GSM8K accuracy

Full GSM8K test split with EvalScope 1.11.1, 0-shot, batch 8, `temperature=0`, seed 42, and `max_tokens=65536`:

| Partition | Correct | Accuracy |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Baseline 14/26 | 1260/1319 | 95.527% |
| PR 11/29 | 1258/1319 | 95.375% |

`11/29` was 2 questions (0.152 percentage points) lower. The paired difference was not statistically significant (baseline-only correct 12, PR-only correct 10, McNemar exact p=0.832); both runs completed 1319/1319 with no API errors, output-cap hits, or restarts.

## Details

Generalize the cache-relay approach to track live sharing sources at each stage boundary. Reuse PP intermediate tensors and register receiver caches under their original source-layer names so the scheduler retains consistent cache groups across stages. Only newly written rows at completed compression boundaries are copied; padding and skipped slots are masked.

Cross-stage relay requires Model Runner V2, packed FlashMLA caches, and PCP=DCP=1, without speculative decoding, KV transfer, or microbatching. Replicas add cache memory and communication overhead. The existing decoder-side layer-replay guard disables batch shrinking when the final KV source and its consumers span stages. Existing PCP restrictions remain unchanged.

No open PR was found that implements DeepSeek-V4.1 cross-stage cache relay. AI assistance was used to prepare this change.

 from .test_fused_indexer_q_rope_quant import quantize_to_mxfp4
 
 
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="CUDA only")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "row_bytes,value_bytes", [(584, 576), (528, 528), (288, 288), (132, 128), (68, 64)]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("compress_ratio", [1, 2])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "num_tokens,use_graph", [(1, False), (17, False), (1025, True)]
+)
+def test_pipeline_cache_relay_preserves_bytes_and_page_padding(
+    row_bytes, value_bytes, compress_ratio, num_tokens, use_graph
+):
+    """Relays remap physical pages, skip invalid/open groups and replay graphs."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops.fused_compress_quant_cache import (
+        copy_pipeline_cache_rows,
+    )
+
+    block_size = 32
+    num_blocks = math.ceil(num_tokens / block_size) + 1
+    stride = block_size * row_bytes + 256
+    source_cpu = torch.randint(0, 256, (num_blocks, stride), dtype=torch.uint8)
+    source_backing = source_cpu.cuda()
+    target_backing = torch.full_like(source_backing, 5)
+    source = source_backing.as_strided(
+        (num_blocks, block_size, row_bytes), (stride, row_bytes, 1)
+    )
+    target = target_backing.as_strided(source.shape, source.stride())
+    # Offset views exercise the alignment variants used by sliced PP batches.
+    positions = torch.arange(num_tokens + 1, device="cuda")[1:]
+    source_slots = torch.arange(num_tokens + 1, device="cuda")[1:]
+    source_slots[::5] = -1
+    # Match valid rows, while using a different physical location on the receiver.
+    target_slots = torch.where(source_slots >= 0, source_slots + block_size, -1)
+    rows = torch.empty((num_tokens + 1, row_bytes), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)[
+        1:
+    ]
+
+    def relay():
+        copy_pipeline_cache_rows(
+            source,
+            rows,
+            positions,
+            source_slots,
+            compress_ratio,
+            value_bytes,
+            scatter=False,
+        )
+        copy_pipeline_cache_rows(
+            target,
+            rows,
+            positions,
+            target_slots,
+            compress_ratio,
+            value_bytes,
+            scatter=True,
+        )
+
+    relay()
+    if use_graph:
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            relay()
+        source_backing.bitwise_xor_(1)
+        source_cpu.bitwise_xor_(1)
+        target_backing.fill_(5)
+        graph.replay()
+    expected_rows = torch.zeros((num_tokens, row_bytes), dtype=torch.uint8)
+    expected_target = torch.full_like(source_cpu, 5)
+    byte = torch.arange(row_bytes)
+
+    def offsets(slot):
+        row = slot % block_size
+        return torch.where(
+            byte < value_bytes,
+            row * value_bytes + byte,
+            block_size * value_bytes
+            + row * (row_bytes - value_bytes)
+            + byte
+            - value_bytes,
+        )
+
+    for token, (src, dst, pos) in enumerate(
+        zip(
+            source_slots.cpu().tolist(),
+            target_slots.cpu().tolist(),
+            positions.cpu().tolist(),
+        )
+    ):
+        if src >= 0 and (pos + 1) % compress_ratio == 0:
+            expected_rows[token] = source_cpu[src // block_size, offsets(src)]
+            expected_target[dst // block_size, offsets(dst)] = expected_rows[token]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(rows.cpu(), expected_rows)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(target_backing.cpu(), expected_target)
+

+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, cast

+import torch
+from torch import nn

+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention_layer_base import AttentionLayerBase

+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.attention import (

+        DeepseekV4IndexerCache,

+    from vllm.v1.attention.backend import AttentionBackend
+    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import KVCacheSpec

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PipelineBoundary:
+    kv_source: int | None = None
+    index_source: int | None = None
+    candidate_source: int | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def needs_relay(self) -> bool:
+        return any(
+            source is not None
+            for source in (self.kv_source, self.index_source, self.candidate_source)
+        )
+
+
+def get_pipeline_boundaries(
+    config: Any, stage_ranges: list[tuple[int, int]]
+) -> tuple[PipelineBoundary, ...]:
+    """Resolve cache, top-k and candidate lifetimes at every stage cut."""
+    num_layers = config.num_hidden_layers
+    if (
+        not stage_ranges
+        or stage_ranges[0][0] != 0
+        or stage_ranges[-1][1] != num_layers
+        or any(start >= end for start, end in stage_ranges)
+        or any(a[1] != b[0] for a, b in zip(stage_ranges, stage_ranges[1:]))
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("DeepSeek-V4.1 pipeline stages must partition all layers")
+    ratios = config.compress_ratios
+    if len(ratios) < num_layers or any(r not in (0, 1, 2) for r in ratios):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid DeepSeek-V4.1 compress_ratios")
+    sources = {}
+    for kind, field in (
+        ("kv", "kv_source_layer_ids"),
+        ("index", "index_source_layer_ids"),
+    ):
+        values = tuple(getattr(config, field, ()) or ())
+        if (
+            values != tuple(sorted(set(values)))
+            or any(type(s) is not int or not 0 <= s < num_layers for s in values)
+            or any(ratios[s] == 0 for s in values)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid DeepSeek-V4.1 {field}")
+        sources[kind] = values
+    if not set(sources["kv"]).issubset(sources["index"]):
+        raise ValueError("KV sources must also publish index keys")
+    dependencies: dict[str, list[tuple[int, int]]] = {"kv": [], "index": []}
+    for layer in range(num_layers):
+        if ratios[layer] == 0:
+            continue
+        for kind, values in sources.items():
+            preceding = [s for s in values if s <= layer]
+            if not preceding:
+                raise ValueError(f"Layer {layer} has no preceding {kind} source")
+            source = preceding[-1]
+            if ratios[source] != ratios[layer]:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Layer {layer} and its {kind} source disagree on ratio"
+                )
+            dependencies[kind].append((source, layer))

+    candidate_enabled = (
+        candidate >= 0 and getattr(config, "candidate_topk_blocks", 0) > 0

+                index_source=live["index"],

+        assert self.backend is not None

+                cast(Any, metadata[prefix]).slot_mapping,
+                self.config.compress_ratios[boundary.kv_source],
+                value_bytes,
+                scatter=importing,
+            )
+        for key, buffer in (("pp_topk", topk), ("pp_candidates", candidates)):
+            if key in tensors:
+                assert buffer is not None
+                if importing:
+                    buffer[: positions.numel()].copy_(tensors[key])
+                else:
+                    tensors[key].copy_(buffer[: positions.numel()])
+        return tensors
